description.en:
Makes a player "tough" for the match, or ends it: their clashes stop costing them anything.
It adds the player to (or removes them from) the match's tough list with three protections:
- no GP loss from clashes;
- no TP cost for their commands while their Fighting Spirit is not out;
- no Fighting Spirit gauge cost while it is out.
CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_TOUGH_ONLY_TP uses the same list with only the TP protection. Calling one after the other for the same player replaces that player's protections. Players in the forced-win list (CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN) get all three protections as well.

The player can be given in three ways, chosen by the number of arguments (same rules as CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN):
- 2 arguments (enable, charaId): by parameter ID.
- 3 arguments (enable, memberIndex, teamSlot): member number memberIndex of that team's match roster, turned into its parameter ID at the time of the call.
- 4 arguments (enable, slotOffset, teamSlot, any): whoever stands at position slotOffset among that team's players on the pitch. The fourth argument is not read.
The list holds up to 32 entries. CMND_BTL_RESET_FORCE_TOUGH empties it.
true to protect the player, false to remove them from the tough list.

2-argument form: parameter ID (e.g. "para_cp0008").
3-argument form: member number in the team's match roster.
4-argument form: position offset among the team's players on the pitch.
3- and 4-argument forms: team of the player, 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Only there to select the 4-argument form; never read.

examples.case: Protecting the opponent's ace for a scripted beat (real usage, from btl0016.nut)
